item.alltheimbaium.auto_farmland.summary: Crops on top are harvested over and over, and the drops go straight into the machine.
item.alltheimbaium.auto_farmland.usage.1: Plant a crop on top and it starts producing immediately — no manual harvesting
item.alltheimbaium.auto_farmland.usage.2: Only regular crops are harvested; nether wart and pumpkin/melon stems are not
item.alltheimbaium.auto_farmland.usage.3: Products accumulate as §ebig numbers§7 across §e27 rows§7, extractable in the GUI or by pipes
item.alltheimbaium.auto_farmland.warn.1: The top face is reserved for planting — open the GUI from a side or the bottom
item.alltheimbaium.clock.summary: Drives adjacent machines extra ticks, up to §e1024×§7 speed.
item.alltheimbaium.clock.usage.1: Only machines with a block entity are sped up; plain blocks get exactly §e1§7 extra random tick
item.alltheimbaium.clock.usage.2: Each of the six faces can be toggled; speed has §e10 steps from §e2§7 to §e1024
item.alltheimbaium.clock.usage.3: The global switch affects every clock at once and resets to its default on relog
item.alltheimbaium.clock.warn.1: It never speeds up other Acceleration Clocks, so they cannot stack on each other
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.summary: Right-click to strike every mob in range, then settle each weapon in its slots in turn.
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.usage.1: The sword's own damage = the summed attack of every distinct damage item in its slots, minimum §e1
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.usage.2: After the hit, every weapon in its slots also strikes the target once, using that weapon's own damage and on-hit enchantments
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.usage.3: Enchantments come from books in its slots: levels 1~10 are worth §e1/2/4/8/16/32/64/128/256/512§7 points, and the summed points decide the level (capped at 10)
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.usage.4: ALT+right-click opens the config GUI: kill mode / range / 27 item slots
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.usage.5: Strikes bypass the damage immunity of Draconic-Evolution's Chaos Guardian
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.warn.1: Cannot be enchanted, smithed, or used as a crafting material
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_sword.warn.2: Each item counts toward damage only once — duplicates in the slots do not add up
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_totem.summary: Triggers on death, cancelling it and leaving you at 1 HP — reusable forever.
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_totem.usage.1: Works from anywhere in your inventory or accessory slots — no need to hold it
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_totem.usage.2: On trigger it clears every effect, then grants 40 s Fire Resistance / 45 s Regeneration II / 5 s Absorption II
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_totem.usage.3: The 27 potion/food slots: potions apply one by one, and food is eaten one by one (e.g. a golden apple's Regeneration and Absorption) — neither is §econsumed
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_totem.usage.4: ALT+right-click opens the config GUI: the potion and food slots, and the Ultimate → Creative Chemical Tank conversion
item.alltheimbaium.eternal_totem.warn.1: You are left at 1 HP, so get clear of the damage source right after reviving
The connected range is rescanned every §e1 s§7, so a new machine is picked up within a second
Searches along this mod's blocks and AutoResource's, merging every machine it reaches into one read-only view.
No need to touch the machine — it is found as long as ATI or AutoResource blocks bridge the gap
Read-only: pipes can pull, but nothing can be pushed back into the machines
Extracted: Storage Block Fountain / Liquid Infinity Fountain / Mob Farm / Resource Farm / Auto Farmland, plus every AutoResource machine except the Water Wheel Motor
Conducts only, never extracted: ATI Farmland / Instant Furnace / Instant Inscriber / AutoResource Water Wheel Motor, and the interface itself
The search only follows this mod's blocks and AutoResource's — the floor a Generation Platform lays down is vanilla blocks and breaks the link
Vanilla chests and containers from other mods are never aggregated
item.alltheimbaium.farmland.summary: Crops planted on top mature instantly.
item.alltheimbaium.farmland.usage.1: Only crops: wheat / carrot / potato / beetroot / nether wart, plus pumpkin and melon stems
item.alltheimbaium.farmland.usage.2: Always counts as hydrated — no water needed, and it never reverts to dirt
item.alltheimbaium.farmland.usage.3: Saplings and other non-crops cannot be planted on it
item.alltheimbaium.farmland.warn.1: Placing several pumpkin or melon stems next to each other may cause the stems to drop
item.alltheimbaium.instant_furnace.param: §e18 input§7 and §e18 output§7 item types, stored as big numbers with no 64 stack limit
item.alltheimbaium.instant_furnace.summa: Anything entering the input area is smelted instantly, at §e1000 FE§7 per item.
item.alltheimbaium.instant_furnace.usage: Shift+click an item in your inventory, or click the deposit button, to merge it into the input rows
Taking items is always: click for 1 · Shift-click for a stack · Space-click to fill your inventory
The six output buttons have only two states — Push / Off — toggled face by face
Accepts FE only — it never outputs power
item.alltheimbaium.instant_inscriber.par: §e18 input§7 / §e9 output§7 item types, stored as big numbers
item.alltheimbaium.instant_inscriber.sum: Generates AE2 inscriber recipes instantly, at §e1000 FE§7 per product.
item.alltheimbaium.instant_inscriber.usa: §ePress§7: consumes only the middle material; the top and bottom templates are neither needed nor consumed, and one material yields every press it feeds into
§eAssemble§7: consumes all materials in the top, middle and bottom slots, running 3-material recipes before 2-material ones
Taking items is always: click for 1 · Shift-click for a stack · Space-click to fill your inventory
item.alltheimbaium.instant_inscriber.war: Depends on AE2 inscriber recipes — with AE2 absent it produces nothing
Accepts FE only — it never outputs power
item.alltheimbaium.liquid_fountain.summa: Turns one fluid infinite — once it crosses the threshold it never runs dry.
item.alltheimbaium.liquid_fountain.usage: Accepts a single fluid only — a second one is rejected
Right-click with an empty or filled container to draw or pour directly; the + slot in the GUI handles containers automatically
Once infinite, all six faces push a full load every tick, toggleable face by face
Below the threshold it never pushes outward, but pipes can still drain its stock
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.param.1: Output rate: §eweight × level ÷ 500§7 items/s; the level rises by 1 every §e20 s
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.summary: Contain a mob once and it keeps dropping its loot forever.
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.usage.1: While empty, right-click to capture the nearest mob within 5 blocks; it is only placed down if nothing was captured
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.usage.2: You can also contain the mob after placing it, by putting a spawn egg or that mob's signature drop into the marker slot
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.usage.3: Once contained, that slot becomes a use slot: shears / a bucket / a bowl / a glass bottle are right-clicked on the mob for you, with no durability cost
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.usage.4: Products accumulate as §ebig numbers§7 across §e27 rows§7, extractable in the GUI or by pipes
item.alltheimbaium.mob_farm.warn.1: Each farm can contain only once — no cancelling or swapping
item.alltheimbaium.package_material_x1.s: The shared crafting base for every machine and material in this mod.
item.alltheimbaium.platform.summary: Lays out a floating platform spanning §e3×3 chunks§7 (§e48×48 blocks§7) at its own height.
item.alltheimbaium.platform.usage.1: Shift+right-click generates the whole area; right-click opens the GUI to generate or rebuild chunk by chunk
item.alltheimbaium.platform.usage.2: The edges are stone bricks, the interior is smooth stone, and its inner corners are ochre froglights
item.alltheimbaium.platform.usage.3: The disguise switch in the GUI is global: turning it on shows every platform top as stone bricks
item.alltheimbaium.platform.warn.1: Only air and the platform's own blocks are replaced; anything else is skipped
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.param.1: Output rate: §eweight × level ÷ 500§7 items/s; the level rises by 1 every §e20 s
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.summary: Mark one resource and it keeps producing everything derived from it.
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.usage.1: Drop one marker into the marker slot to start producing; the marker stays there on display
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.usage.2: Markers include cobblestone / any sapling / bamboo / sugar cane / ice / bone meal / flowers / mushrooms and more
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.usage.3: Products accumulate as §ebig numbers§7 across §e27 rows§7, extractable in the GUI or by pipes
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.usage.4: Hover the §e?§7 at the GUI's top-right for the full marker → products table
item.alltheimbaium.resource_farm.warn.1: Each farm can be marked only once — no cancelling or swapping

item.alltheimbaium.supply_crate.usage.2: Spend §e1 point§7 to refresh and immediately reroll the whole list
item.alltheimbaium.supply_crate.usage.3: Supply points come from: §e+1 per 30 min§7 of playtime, §e+5§7 per achievement
